text:
maria: Quick sync  PartnerPulse landing wants exact 09:00 PT publish tomorrow; partner expects hero, badge, and SI link live at the same second.

sahil: ops schedule shows a CDN maintenance at 09:05 PT that could interfere with immediate purge.

kevin: suggestion: pre-stage hero behind feature-flag and flip at 09:00 PT to avoid deploy contention. Ops can run purge at 09:12 PT after maintenance window.

laura: partner insists on hero+blog simultaneous launch for PR. They also need the promo code and UTM confirmed.

partner-bot: uploaded asset: partnerpulse/hero-final at s3://marketplace/partnerpulse/hero-final (uploaded 07:18 PT).

maria: UTM confirmed by partner: utm_source=partnerpulse&utm_campaign=pp_launch_q2; promo=PP15. Adding to asset sheet.

opsbot: scheduled preview 08:00 PT on staging-2, dry-run 08:50 PT (internal), flip 09:00 PT, CDN purge 09:12 PT. Reminders sent to #release-war-room.

kevin: SI checklist: ensure egress whitelist and token exchange. After flip ops will run: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://si.partnerpulse.com/health | jq -r .status` expecting "ok".

laura: Legal crediting line: "Partner content provided by PartnerPulse." I'll paste final copy at 08:30 PT. Do not flip until legal copy is confirmed in meta.

maria: owners: assets=partner-bot, ops=kevin, press=laura, partner-liaison=sahil. Preview agenda: visual QA, feature-flag preview, analytics test, SI smoke dry-run.

sahil: partner-mobile crop tweak requested; they pushed a small update. Preview link: https://staging-2.redwood.ai/partnerpulse/hero-preview

kevin: saw preview; mobile crop fixed. Ops will be in #release-war-room for dry-run and live flip.

maria: if anything blocks we'll move flip to 09:30 PT and notify press. Otherwise proceed on schedule. Thanks team :thumbsup:
